items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: They were built on the style of Bubba Nisky.

ctx.x: For the simple reason why, I think our music was on too high a plane for it. See Duke came in and his band played what they called 'jungle music'. They were built on the style of Bubba Nisky. And that was the people in that place were Beer Barons, and all like that. They could stand it. When I was down in the Club Alabam, they wouldn't allow us to beat four beats out.
